period_note: SOUTH BANGLA AGRICULTURE AND COMMERCE BANK LIMITED (pre-2023 name). SOLO/STANDALONE basis, unaudited. Balance sheet is the 31-March-2018 period-end snapshot (reported), compared against 31-December-2017 (audited). Income-statement items are for Q1 itself. Total assets (59,791,626,258), total liabilities (53,111,939,200) and total equity (6,679,687,058, confirmed both by total_assets-minus-total_liabilities and by summing the five reported equity components, which agree to within Tk.1) all reconcile. VALUABLE CROSS-VALIDATION of an existing dataset record: this filing's own 31-Dec-2017 comparative column shows total shareholders' equity of Tk.6,538,992,141 -- matching, to within Tk.1, this bank's existing 2017_Q4.json record (6,538,992,142), which sources.json documents as a value 'corrected' from a garbled OCR read of the FY2018 annual report (6,538,997,141); this independent quarterly filing confirms the corrected figure, not the garbled one. Q1-2018's own P&L (interest income 1,449,251,958 etc.) exactly reproduces the comparative column later printed in this bank's own 2019_Q1.json filing for every line down to 'Profit before taxes' (279,708,417) -- but DATA-QUALITY FINDING: the 2019_Q1.json filing's own comparative-column 'Provision for taxation' cell for this same period prints Tk.145,755,305 (identical to that column's own 'Total provision' figure directly above it, i.e. an apparent copy/transcription duplication within the LATER report), producing a divergent restated PAT of Tk.133,953,112 there vs this filing's own contemporaneous, audited-chain-consistent PAT of Tk.130,796,114.25 (both filings agree exactly on pre-tax profit of 279,708,417); this dataset keeps Q1-2018's own first-published PAT as the primary record, per the project's contemporaneous-over-restated preference, and flags the divergence here. PAT is printed with a residual Tk.0.25 fraction (130,796,114.25); the balance sheet's own 'Current year's profit' cell shows the rounded 130,796,114, an immaterial difference. Printed 'Earning per share (Annualized)' of 1.0495 is PAT/shares (498,522,240) x4 = 1.0496, rounding to 1.0495; eps_cumulative below is back-derived (1.0495/4=0.26). No classified-loans/NPL, provision, capital-adequacy or NAV-per-share disclosure in this filing -- recorded as a gap.
